title: Glowing key
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff6b0' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#fff6b0' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='gold' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe873'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ffc93c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8a41c'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- ring (bow) of the key -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='40' r='13' fill='none' stroke='url(#gold)' stroke-width='5.5'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='40' r='13' fill='none' stroke='#fff3a8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- shaft -->
  <rect x='38' y='36.5' width='40' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <rect x='38' y='37.5' width='40' height='2' rx='1' fill='#fff3a8' fill-opacity='0.75'/>

  <!-- teeth -->
  <rect x='62' y='42' width='6' height='9' rx='1.5' fill='#ffc93c'/>
  <rect x='62' y='42' width='6' height='2' fill='#fff3a8' fill-opacity='0.7'/>
  <rect x='71' y='42' width='5' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#ffc93c'/>
  <rect x='71' y='42' width='5' height='2' fill='#fff3a8' fill-opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M74 20 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2 z' fill='#fff8c8'/>
  <path d='M86 46 l1.4 3.5 3.5 1.4 -3.5 1.4 -1.4 3.5 -1.4 -3.5 -3.5 -1.4 3.5 -1.4 z' fill='#ffe873'/>
  <path d='M18 76 l1.2 3 3 1.2 -3 1.2 -1.2 3 -1.2 -3 -3 -1.2 3 -1.2 z' fill='#fff8c8'/>
</svg>
